nodes.question: What are some types of onsite sanitation technologies mentioned in the text?
nodes.answer: The types of onsite sanitation technologies include septic tanks, aqua privies, pit latrines (including Ventilated Improved Pit Latrines), public ablution blocks, and dry toilets.
